mapper.select: SELECT supplier_id AS supplierId, business_number AS businessNumber, company_name AS companyName, representative_name AS representativeName, phone, com_phone AS comPhone, category, updated_date AS updatedDate, registration_date AS registrationDate, category_name AS categoryName FROM suppliers WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO suppliers (business_number, company_name, representative_name, phone, com_phone, category, subcategory, company_e_name, registration_date) VALUES (#{businessNumber}, #{companyName}, #{representativeName}, #{phone}, #{comPhone}, #{category}, #{subcategory}, #{companyEName}, #{registrationDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE suppliers SET business_number = #{businessNumber}, company_name = #{companyName}, representative_name = #{representativeName}, phone = #{phone}, com_phone = #{comPhone}, category = #{category}, subcategory = #{subcategory}, company_e_name = #{companyEName}, updated_date = #{updatedDate} WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId}
